reasoning_content:
The build of mfe-ewm failed inside the frontend Docker build: it's looking for `/app/mfe-ewm/shared/tsconfig.json`, but it doesn't exist. This seems to be a problem with the mfe-ewm configuration. Let's look at mfe-ewm's vite configuration and understand what's being referenced.

Let's check whether the mfe-ewm directory has a symbolic link to shared, or a shared subdirectory.

action.command: cd /workspace/01-frontend && ls -la mfe-ewm/ | head -30; echo "=== shared ref in vite config:"; grep -rn 'shared/tsconfig\|shared' mfe-ewm/vite.config.* 2>/dev/null | head; echo "=== tsconfig.json in mfe-ewm:"; cat mfe-ewm/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -30

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /workspace/01-frontend && ls -la mfe-ewm/ | head -30; echo \"=== shared ref in vite config:\"; grep -rn 'shared/tsconfig\\|shared' mfe-ewm/vite.config.* 2>/dev/null | head; echo \"=== tsconfig.json in mfe-ewm:\"; cat mfe-ewm/tsconfig.json 2>/dev/null | head -30", "security_risk": "LOW", "summary": "Inspect mfe-ewm shared references"}
